hypothesis: After restricting raw v3 contacts to both endpoints in the frozen metadata node set, every directed pair has exactly the published v3 edgelist multiplicity.
acceptance: Every raw pre/post record is read exactly once per run; counters account for all metadata-membership categories.
Reference nodes are unique sorted unsigned 64-bit integers; no floating-point identity conversion.
Reference directed pairs are unique, strictly positive-weight and have known unequal endpoints.
Zero differing pair multiplicities and zero unexpected induced pairs; matching node totals alone is insufficient.
Canonical CSR has deterministic node IDs, row offsets, ascending targets and integer contact weights.
Independent Python readback checks byte length, dimensions, index bounds, row ordering and weight total.
Synthetic wrong-pair equal-node-total, count-mismatch, malformed-input and reordered-input tests pass.
Graph files stay outside Git and are not released when pairwise reconciliation fails.
